rejection_codes.INSUFFICIENT_OVERLAP_EVIDENCE: Observation timestamp list is missing and no verified completeness attestation exists, or timestamps are unparseable.
rejection_codes.DISJOINT_OBSERVATION_WINDOWS: Candidate observation windows or timestamp sets have empty intersection (N_shared == 0).
rejection_codes.INSUFFICIENT_OVERLAP: Candidate timestamp sets share between 1 and 99 observations (N_shared < 100).
rejection_codes.DUPLICATED_OBSERVATIONS_DETECTED: Candidate series contains non-unique timestamps before or after canonical UTC normalization.
rejection_codes.SAMPLING_CADENCE_MISMATCH: Candidates have conflicting window cadences without registered normalization.

verification_rules: Every candidate observation timestamp must parse to a valid timezone-aware datetime and normalize to YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.
Candidate series must contain zero duplicates.
Intersection must be performed using mathematical set intersection across all candidates.
N_shared is strictly the cardinality of the intersection set.
Start and end of overlap are derived from min(S_shared) and max(S_shared).
